My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
If an item arrived damaged, please inspect your order upon reception and initiate an EXCHANGE REQUEST THROUGH THE RETURN PORTAL, selecting the appropriate return reason.
You’ll be asked to provide:
- a brief description of the damaged item
- an image of the item
- an image of the care tag located on the inside of the garment
Their team will review the request, and IF IT’S APPROVED, YOU’LL RECEIVE AN EMAIL WITH A PREPAID LABEL.
Also, the policy says ONLY ITEMS RECEIVED DAMAGED OR INCORRECT ARE ELIGIBLE FOR AN EXCHANGE, and they CAN ONLY EXCHANGE THE SAME STYLE.
If you want help with your specific order, please log in and I can guide you from there.
